title: Smart Data Models - ERA RINF - ETCS
description: ETCS (era:ETCS's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): TSI compliant train protection system ERTMS / ETCS application level and baseline related to the track side equipment.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ETCS'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

dNvovtrp.description: Property. Maximum distance for overriding the train trip in metres, according to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C]. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.5, 1.2.1.1.1.16.5)

dNvpotrp.description: Property. Maximum distance for reversing in Post Trip mode in metres, according to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C]. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.7, 1.2.1.1.1.16.7)

dNvroll.description:
Property. Parameter used by the ETCS on-board to supervise the distance allowed to be travelled under the roll-away protection and the reverse movement protection, in metres
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.1, 1.2.1.1.1.16.1)

etcsBaseline.description: Property. ETCS baseline installed lineside. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.2, 1.2.1.1.1.2) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS Baselines' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-baselines/ETCSBaselines), 7 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

etcsImplementsLevelCrossingProcedure.description: Property. If the trackside does not implement any solution to cover non-protected LXs (which are normally protected by means of a technical system), then drivers will be required to comply with instructions received from other sources (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.13, 1.2.1.1.1.13)

etcsInfill.description: Property. Information about installed trackside equipment capable to transmit infill information by loop or Global System for Mobile communications for Railways (GSM-R) for level 1 installations. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.4, 1.2.1.1.1.4) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS Infills' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-infills/ETCSInfills), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

etcsInfillLineAccess.description: Property. Indication whether infill is required to access the line for safety reasons. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.3, 1.2.1.1.1.3)

etcsLevelType.description: Property. ETCS application level related to the track side equipment. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.1, 1.2.1.1.1.1) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS Levels' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-levels/ETCSLevels), 5 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

etcsMVersion.description: Property. ETCS M_version according to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C], SRS 7.5.1.79. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.10, 1.2.1.1.1.10) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS M Versions' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-m-versions/ETCSMVersions), 8 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

etcsSystemCompatibility.description: Property. ETCS requirements used for demonstrating technical compatibility. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.9, 1.2.1.1.1.9) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS System Compatibilities' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-system-compatibilities/ETCSSystemCompatibilities), 146 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

etcsTransmitsTrackConditions.description:
Property. If the trackside does not provide Track Conditions, the driver will need to be informed about such conditions via alternative methods.
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.12, 1.2.1.1.1.12)

etcsTransmittedTrackConditions.description: Property. Transmittable track conditions by the CCSSubsystem, according to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.12.1, 1.2.1.1.1.12.1) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Track Conditions transmitted to the Onboard (Subset-026, version 4.0 - 5.8.12)' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/transmitted-tcs/TransmittedTrackConditions), 14 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

hasETCSRestrictionsConditions.description: Property. Indication whether restrictions or conditions due to partial compliance with the TSI CCS exist. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.6, 1.2.1.1.1.6)

hasEtcsNationalPacket44.description: Property. Indication whether data for national packet 44 applications is transmitted between track and train. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.5, 1.2.1.1.1.5)

mNvcontact.description:
Property. On-Board system reaction when T_NVCONTACT expires
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.9, 1.2.1.1.1.16.9) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS Reactions after expired T_NVCONTACT' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-reactions-contact/ETCSReactionsNVContact), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

mNvderun.description: Property. Entry of Driver ID permitted while running According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.10, 1.2.1.1.1.16.10)

nationalValuesBrakeModel.description:
Property. Set of parameters for adapting the braking curves calculated by the ETCS on-board system to match accuracy, performance and safety margins imposed by the infrastructure manager.
It copies the content of Packet 3 or of Packet 203 as defined in the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C]. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.13, 1.2.1.1.1.16.13)

qNvdriverAdhes.description:
Property. Qualifier determining whether the driver is allowed to modify the adhesion factor used by the ETCS on-board to calculate the braking curves.
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.11, 1.2.1.1.1.16.11) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Driver allowed to change adhesion factor Qualifiers' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/adhf-qualifier/AdhesionFactorChange), 2 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

qNvemrrls.description:
Property. Qualifier defining whether the application of the emergency brake for reasons other than a trip can be revoked as soon as the conditions for it have disappeared or after the train has come to a complete standstill.
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.2, 1.2.1.1.1.16.2) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'Emergency Brake Release Command Qualifiers' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/ebr-qualifier/EBReleaseQualifier), 2 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

qNvsbtsmperm.description: Property. Permission to use service brake in target speed monitoring (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.12, 1.2.1.1.1.16.12)

reasonsEtcsRadioBlockCenterReject.description: Property. List of cases subject to system design choices made by the infrastructure manager according to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.15, 1.2.1.1.1.15) Controlled-vocabulary value: IRI of a skos:Concept from ERA's 'ETCS Reasons RBC can reject a train' SKOS concept scheme (http://data.europa.eu/949/concepts/etcs-rbc-reject-reasons/ETCSRBCRejectionReasons), 4 concepts, enumerated below from era-skos.

tNvcontact.description:
Property. Maximum time without a safe message from Radio Block Center before train reacts in seconds.
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.8, 1.2.1.1.1.16.8)

tNvovtrp.description:
Property. Maximum time for overriding the train trip in seconds.
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.6, 1.2.1.1.1.16.6)

trainIntegrityOnBoardRequired.description: Property. Indication whether train confirmation from on-board is required to access the line for safety reasons. (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.8, 1.2.1.1.1.8)

vNvallowovtrp.description:
Property. Speed limit allowing the driver to select the  override  function in km/h
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.3, 1.2.1.1.1.16.3)

vNvsupovtrp.description:
Property. Override speed limit to be supervised when the "override" function is active in km/h.
According to the specification referenced in Appendix A-1, index [C] (RINF register parameter index: 1.1.1.3.2.16.4, 1.2.1.1.1.16.4)
